## Content context

The Markdown files mirror the public HTML pages. Tactical is a presentation of the same portfolio; its hash routes are not separate canonical pages. Keep stated project-validation and resume-source caveats when describing results. Contact uses the public Google Form linked from the contact page. Local browser/location widgets and decorative signal graphics are not portfolio facts or live project measurements.
